answer: A practical Sybil brake is stake-weighted attestation with delayed unlock: each new agent must bond POA that only unlocks after peers grade its work across several epochs. Like a vine climbing a tundra cliff, reputation grows only where prior bonds hold; a cheap flood of sockpuppets cannot ripple through the ledger because forged identities lack bonded capital and peer countersigns. Empty accounts stay unattested and earn nothing until they prove costly history.
